owns: safe bounded workbook inspection and parsing
versioned source profiles, header registries and field authority
logical source fingerprints and replay classification
bounded import-run/job history and source coverage warnings
does_not_own: Service Request or RFC lifecycle truth
domain audit semantics beyond emitting governed references
crossing_rules: Adapters may emit normalized observations but may not write owning-domain aggregates directly.
Only accepted proposals invoke owning-domain commands.
Every owning-domain command revalidates current state inside its own transaction boundary.
Rejected, deferred or unresolved observations remain import/proposal evidence only.
Import status or source presence never substitutes for domain lifecycle state.

source_family_variation.advanced_search: May use its own discovery schedule, field allowlist and source semantics while converging on the common staging/review model.
source_family_variation.enhanced_rfc: Uses exact RFC identity/header rules and deterministic candidate ranking; filesystem ranking metadata is not RFC business chronology.
source_family_variation.wfm: Uses exact RFC No./Task No. identity and supported embedded source chronology; repeated RFC No. with different Task No. is valid.
